title: Roamboard cost mosaic: lineage export & differential pricing pattern canvas
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, role-aware console panel that surfaces token-level cost breakdowns, lineage-based attribution, and exportable price-slab scenarios. The Roamboard Cost Mosaic combines a timeline microledger, per-route marginal cost tiles, and differential pricing pattern composer to help engineers, finance owners, and product managers reconcile costs and generate CSV/Parquet exports for chargeback. Constraints: must fit inside existing console pane width, support streaming updates from runtime metrics at a controlled cadence, and remain legible at small sparkline sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec with annotated components (ledger sparkline, lineage chains, pricing bands)
Clickable prototype in Figma that covers export flow (CSV/Parquet) and role-aware templates
Usability testing notes from three sessions (engineer, finance PM, design ops) with tracked success metrics
Design tokens and spacing that match Console theme and accessibility AA contrast
Handoff-ready asset with component variants and copy strings for i18n
